doc: A ladder anchored at the top: hi = top * max_frequency; when hi <= low_frequency the result is (hi, 1), else n = floor(ln(hi / low) / ln(lacunarity)) + 1 octaves and the start frequency hi / lacunarity^(n - 1) (so the last octave sits at hi). 20 rows (low, max_frequency, lacunarity, top): the production maps (low 48 at widths 512..16384, low 3 at 256 and 4096), hi == low, hi just above low, hi below low, hi far above (low 0.01, max 1e4 -> 20 octaves), lacunarity 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4 and top 0.5..1.2. No row sits within 1e-6 of a floor boundary of the log ratio (checked at build time; see octave_ladder.fragile). Every row passes lacunarity and top explicitly; the Python defaults (2.03 and 0.95, what texture.py uses) are pinned by octave_ladder.defaults. start: float64 closed form, rtol 1e-9; n: exact.
